thread:
Maya R: FYI canary for new cost-aware routing went live at 08:00 UTC (10%). Invoice preview is showing a small delta for a handful of tenants, flagging now.
Tom B: which ingest path produced the discrepant events? new-route or legacy-ingest?
Maya R: mixed. some events through legacy-ingest, some through new-route. observed header `x-route-priority: cost-aware` on ~30% of the mismatches.
Liam C: quick look: new-route enrichment step seems to drop the `fingerprint` field in some cases. dedupe relies on that.
Sophia P: that would cause missing or split line items in the invoice preview, yep.
Tom B: can you paste a raw event sample (both paths) so we can compare normalization?
Maya R: sample new-route event: ```json
{ "tenant": "acme", "req_id": "req_abc123", "route": "new-route", "tokens": 120, "meta": { "session": "s-9" } }
```
Maya R: legacy-ingest event for same request: ```json
{ "tenant": "acme", "req_id": "req_abc123", "route": "legacy-ingest", "tokens": 120, "meta": { "session": "s-9", "fingerprint": "f_xyz" } }
```
Kevin L: confirmed, `fingerprint` missing in new-route. dedupe window keys on `fingerprint || req_id`. But I see normalization differences on req_id later in pipeline.
Ara S: more precisely: downstream ledger normalizer canonicalizes `req_id` with dashes (`req-abc123`) while new-route emits underscores (`req_abc123`). So when fingerprint missing, they don't match.
Liam C: reproduced locally by replaying two events through canary. mismatch happens in the dedupe lookup step when fingerprint is absent.
Sophia P: mitigation options: 1) rollback canary immediately (stops canary but delays rollout) 2) force enrichment sync in new-route to populate fingerprint (adds latency) 3) add tolerant normalization in dedupe to accept both forms.
Kevin L: I can ship a tiny hotfix to the ledger normalizer to accept both underscore and dash variants for the lookup key. Low blast radius.
Tom B: prefer patch over rollback if safe. any perf risk?
Kevin L: none expected; it's a string normalization in memory before lookup. ETA ~25m to push to canary.
Liam C: I'll add a temporary monitoring alert to surface this class of mismatch: condition `billing.preview.delta > 0.5% AND missing_fingerprint=true` so we can auto-detect recurrence.
Maya R: please also surface 5 sample raw events in the Console preview UI (tenant, raw_event_snippet) — PM will want that in the rollout checklist.
Sophia P: filing PM ticket CONSOLE-1123 for the sample event view and a note in rollout playbook about fingerprint assumptions.
Kevin L: deploying normalizer patch to canary: /deploy ledger-normalizer v0.9.3-canary
ingest-bot: deploy started: ledger-normalizer v0.9.3-canary (canary=10%)
Tom B: seeing preview delta reduce after ~7m, looks promising.
Liam C: alert added, muted for maintenance window. query used: `sum(rate(billing_preview_delta{fingerprint_missing=\"true\"}[5m])) by (tenant)`
Maya R: monitoring for two canary windows. rollback threshold set at 0.5% delta sustained for 10m.
Sophia P: noted, will add to release notes and PM doc.
Tom B: also adding a short-term reconciliation job to scan recent invoices for entries with req_id variants and synthesize missing fingerprints for audit.
Ara S: good idea. keep logs of any synthetic fingerprints added so auditing stays clean.
Maya R: action items recap: Kevin ships normalization hotfix (ETA 25m), Liam creates alert (done), Tom kicks off reconciliation scan (ETA 1h), Sophia files PM ticket and updates release notes.
Kevin L: patch is live in canary. /deploy reported success.
ingest-bot: deploy succeeded: ledger-normalizer v0.9.3-canary
Tom B: preview delta is back within expected noise for affected tenants. I'll keep eyes on it for the next cycles.
Maya R: thanks all. if anything regresses reopen thread.
